Alok Singh — Show Creator

Creative contribution to Gorakhpur's Got Latent

Alok Singh is credited as one of the Show Creators of Gorakhpur's Got Latent (GGL), alongside Naveen Varma. This credit recognises his association with the creative work behind the show.

GGL presents a range of performance and entertainment categories, bringing local talent and audiences together. Creating a show experience involves more than what viewers see on stage: it also includes planning, presentation, digital communication and the systems that help people engage with the platform.

Alok's wider GGL association includes technology and web development. He is also mentioned informally as “Computer Ji” in a light-hearted way, reflecting the technology side of his public profile.

Naveen Varma is separately identified as GGL's Founder and Host on the official team profile. This page does not change that distinction.
